segments.name: Private Banking & Wealth Management
segments.description: Segment serving private banking and wealth management clients of NatWest Group.
segments.evidence: Effective from Q2 2025, the reportable segment Private Banking was renamed Private Banking & Wealth Management.

changes.text: In 2025, the reportable segment Private Banking was renamed Private Banking & Wealth Management, with no change to its financial results.
changes.evidence: Effective from Q2 2025, the reportable segment Private Banking was renamed Private Banking & Wealth Management. This does not change the financial results of Private Banking & Wealth Management or the consolidated financial results of NatWest Group.
